packageRules.description: Python follows Home Assistant's minimum: hold below 3.15 until HA moves, then raise this with requires-python, ruff's target-version and pyupgrade's --pyXY-plus in one PR.
ruff and its pre-commit hook move together in one PR, for review, so the linter CI runs never disagrees with the one in .venv.
aiohue must equal what HA's hue manifest requires in the HA build pytest-homeassistant-custom-component pins, which Renovate can't see: bump it by hand with that package.
